description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultHttpProxyConfig class, which models the configuration settings for an HTTP proxy within the Eclipse Ditto services. It includes fields such as hostname, port, username, and password, and methods to construct the configuration from a provided Config object, convert it to a ClientTransport, and standard overrides for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultHttpProxyConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of HttpProxyConfig that holds proxy configuration details such as hostname, port, username, and password. Provides methods for creating instances from configuration objects and converting configuration to Akka HTTP ClientTransport.

methods.name: ofHttpProxy
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultHttpProxyConfig using the 'http.proxy' config path.

methods.name: ofProxy
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultHttpProxyConfig using the 'proxy' config path.

methods.name: toClientTransport
methods.description: Converts the proxy configuration into an Akka HTTP ClientTransport object, throwing an error if hostname or port are invalid.
